items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: bekomme die adresse von Mrs. Jaffee.

ctx.x: bekomme die adresse von Mrs. Jaffee.

Oh. bamboo How has it been in the last years? Do you find more radio programs about the right Jazz in Germany and also TV-sendings? In my time, it is now 6 or 7 years ago, when I was interested in Jazz, you had to stay very early to have a Jazz-sendung to hear.
